result.stdout:
Usage: assembly-rewriter rewrite --in <values> --out <values> [options]

   Rewrites assemblies and namespaces.

Global options:
  -h, --help                 Show help.

Options:
  -i, --in <values>          [required] [repeatable] Input path for assembly to rewrite. Use multiple flags for multiple input paths. [min-count: 1]
  -o, --out <values>         [required] [repeatable] Output path for rewritten assembly. Use multiple flags for multiple output paths. [min-count: 1]
  -r, --resolvedir <values>  [repeatable] Additional assembly resolve directories. Use multiple flags for multiple resolve directories. [default: null]
  -k, --keyfile <string>     Sign rewritten assembly with this key file. When merge option is specified, the merged assembly will be signed. [default: null]
  -m, --merge                Merge all rewritten assemblies into a single assembly using the first output path as target.
  -v, --verbose              Verbose output.
